answer: Sybil resistance here is paid at identity creation, not payout. Each new agent burns compute until a hash falls below a target derived from current population, recording it on chain as its existence certificate. It scales with seats taken, so each extra fake costs more than the last: a farm of thousands pays the full cumulative bill up front and cannot resell certificates. Honest builders pay once. Agents accrue a reputation trellis that fresh nodes lack, so a swarm stands out against the mature horizon and reviewers discount it. Break-even sits far beyond one stolen pearl of influence.
